html:
Malindi is a town on the Kenyan coast, a Swahili city-state that in 1498 welcomed Vasco da Gama and gave him a pilot to guide his ships across the Indian Ocean to India.

A rival of Mombasa, Malindi had already sent a giraffe to the Chinese emperor in 1414, an envoy carried home by the fleets of Zheng He. Its ruler saw the Portuguese as allies against Mombasa, and da Gama set up a stone pillar that still stands.

Malindi remained Portugal's friend on the coast until the Portuguese moved to Mombasa in the 1590s, and then declined. Today it is a resort town, near the ruins of Gedi.
sum: Malindi is a town on the Kenyan coast, a Swahili city-state that in 1498 welcomed Vasco da Gama and gave him a pilot to guide his ships across the Indian Ocean to India.
